name: Workers’ Compensation

established.purpose: Internal service fund that charges departments for workers' compensation self-insurance and pays claims

legal_basis: Internal service fund; charges set in the budget; Council may direct transfers by AAO

annual.note: Internal service combining statement, ACFR FY2024 p.311-312. Zero operating revenue: no charges to departments
Internal service combining statement, ACFR FY2025 p.321-322. Zero operating revenue for a second year; expenses $11,983,900; net position fell from $1,944,332 to -$9,752,938

flows.to_fund: Waterfront D and E dock replacement (Marina)
flows.stated_reason: Internal loan of $5.5M in place of a State DBW loan; repaid from Waterfront Transient Occupancy Tax from FY2025 plus a one-time $500,000
flows.terms: Booked in the FY2024 ACFR as a transfer out of $5,500,000, not as a loan receivable; the Marina Operations Fund shows no corresponding loan in. Repayment to this fund is not visible in either ACFR.

flows.stated_reason: Contribution holiday: no workers' compensation charges billed to departments
flows.note: Amount is the foregone charge; the ACFR shows operating revenue of zero against $7.8M of claims and expenses. The normal charge level is not stated in the ACFR.

flows.instrument: FY2025 budget (described as a 'Workers' Compensation holiday' in the Marina Fund Update, May 22, 2025, and in the FY2025 deficit history)
flows.stated_reason: Contribution holiday for a second year
flows.note: Foregone charge not stated. Expenses $11,983,900; net position -$9,752,938 at June 30, 2025.

flows.instrument: FY2026 AAO Amendment, Consent Item 8, November 18, 2025
flows.stated_reason: Transfer to the General Fund: one of the FY2026 one-time measures ('Workers Comp fund') in the budget's deficit history
flows.note: Budgeted; the fund's audited net position was already negative when this was adopted.

obligations.note: Outstanding workers' compensation claims liability is reported in the ACFR self-insurance note; not yet read into this ledger

status.years_in_deficit: Two years of zero revenue; net position negative since FY2025
open_questions: The normal annual charge to departments before the holidays, and when charges resume (FY2027-28 budget).
Whether any Waterfront TOT has been paid to this fund under Resolution 70,997.
The outstanding claims liability and the actuarial funding target.
